urteile.grund: «Firma» is the commercial-register name of the Aktiengesellschaft that waives its audit. eCH-0098 (Genehmigt) has organisationName verbatim in organisationIdentificationType, and the databank maps «Firma» this way in 23 rows. The other candidate, eCH-0010 organisationName, is a postal-address part (3 rows) and fits less well.

Read to the end, the label asks for the first business year in which the waiver of the limited audit (opting-out, OR 727a) takes effect, so it is a validity start for that waiver. I searched every non-repealed standard of the catalogue (290) for audit, revision, waiv, optingOut, fiscalYear, businessYear, financialYear, period, Year/gYear, validFrom, effective, start and Begin. eCH-0229 auditor only identifies the audit firm. eCH-0229 taxPeriod/periodFrom and eCH-0119 taxPeriod give the period a tax return covers. eCH-0276 business-year elements are balance values. eCH-0098, eCH-0108, eCH-0116 and eCH-0148 have no audit or opting-out data. Every validFrom (eCH-0011/0020/0021/0129/0135/0148) belongs to another subject.
urteile.feld: Geschäftsjahr, ab welchem der Verzicht gelten soll

urteile.grund: This composite is the list of all shareholders: Vorname, Name, Anzahl Aktien, then Ort, Datum and Unterschrift. eCH-0276 (Genehmigt) has detailsShareholdersAssociates verbatim in shareholdersAssociatesType, and its type holds name, givenName and amount for each shareholder, so it is the container for this list. Form 361 «Gesellschafter/innen» uses the same container.

This is the shareholder's given name. Because the column «Vorname» exists, the shareholders are natural persons. The atomic rule maps Vorname to eCH-0044 personIdentificationType/firstName (Genehmigt, element exists verbatim).
This is the shareholder's surname, since it stands beside «Vorname». The atomic rule maps Name to eCH-0044 personIdentificationType/officialName (Genehmigt, element exists verbatim).

This is the number of shares the shareholder holds. eCH-0276 shareholdersOrAssociatesType/numberOfSharesUnits (integer, Genehmigt) is the explicit share-count element, its name is unique in the standard, and forms 307, 317 and 359 map «Anzahl Aktien/Stammanteile» to it. detailsShareholdersAssociatesType/amount means the same, but the name «amount» also occurs in freeInputFieldType, so it is ambiguous.

On the Formular this part comes from the column «Ort, Datum» beside «Unterschrift», so it is the place where the shareholder signed, not where they live. I searched the whole catalogue for sign, signature, signing, place, location and locationAnd. eCH-0119 locationAndDate is one combined string inside the attached forms of the natural-person tax return. eCH-0010 town is a part of a postal address. eCH-0039 documentType has only signer, and eCH-0260 signaturesType holds confirmation booleans. The precedent for Ort in «Ort und Datum» is kein_standard.

This is the calendar date on which the shareholder signed (from the column «Ort, Datum» beside «Unterschrift»). I searched the whole catalogue for sign, signature, declarationDate, documentDate, signatureDate, dateOfSign and issueDate. Only eCH-0119 locationAndDate came up, and it is combined and specific to tax returns. eCH-0039 has no signing date, and eCH-0260 signatures are booleans. No element holds the date of signing. The precedent for Datum in «Ort und Datum» is kein_standard.

This confirms the propagated kein_standard (ech_herkunft «propagiert (Name 15x geprüft)»). A handwritten signature has no data element. eCH-0039 signer only names who signed, and eCH-0260 signatures are confirmation booleans for apprenticeship contracts. eCH-0091, 0220, 0230, 0250, 0274 and 0282 cover electronic-signature technique and have no elements.
